SPIRITS_SPEAKEASY.title: Speakeasy
SPIRITS_SPEAKEASY.pages.INITIAL.descript:
A plain door at the end of an alley. [sine][purple]Music leaks up from somewhere below.[/purple][/sine]

A slot at eye level [jitter]slides open[/jitter], and two eyes look you over.

[gold]“Password?”[/gold]
[gold]Finish your drink[/gold]. Choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Upgraded[/gold] Tavern cards to add to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
Even odds: choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]3[/blue] Tavern cards to add to your [gold]Deck[/gold], or lose [red]{BouncerHpLoss}[/red] HP.
Walk back the way you came.
SPIRITS_SPEAKEASY.pages.SWORDFISH.descri:
The door swings open.

Downstairs: a [sine][gold]trumpet[/gold][/sine], [purple]low light[/purple], and a bartender who already knows what you're having.

You drink it. [jitter][red]All of it.[/red][/jitter]
SPIRITS_SPEAKEASY.pages.SWORDFISH.select: Choose a Tavern card to add to your Deck.
SPIRITS_SPEAKEASY.pages.BLUFF_IN.descrip:
A long pause.

[gold]“...Right this way.”[/gold]

You decide [sine]not to ask[/sine] what you said.
SPIRITS_SPEAKEASY.pages.BLUFF_IN.selecti: Choose a Tavern card to add to your Deck.
SPIRITS_SPEAKEASY.pages.BLUFF_OUT.descri:
The door opens just long enough for a [red]very large bouncer[/red] to [jitter]throw you back into the alley[/jitter].

[gold]“Wrong.”[/gold]
SPIRITS_SPEAKEASY.pages.LEAVE.descriptio:
You leave.

Somewhere below, [sine]a whole room laughs[/sine] at a joke you'll never hear.
SPIRITS_SEVEN_GRAND.title: Seven Grand
SPIRITS_SEVEN_GRAND.pages.INITIAL.descri:
A whiskey bar done up like a hunting lodge: [red]plaid[/red], [orange]leather[/orange], and a [gold]stag's head[/gold] keeping an eye on the room.

Behind the bar, a [sine][orange]wall of bottles[/orange][/sine] climbs to the ceiling.

Somewhere in the back, [jitter]pool balls click[/jitter].
SPIRITS_SEVEN_GRAND.pages.INITIAL.option: Take a [gold]Shot[/gold]. Obtain a random [gold]Rare Relic[/gold].
You don't have any cards that can be [gold]Upgraded[/gold].
Bet [red]50[/red] [gold]Gold[/gold] on a game of pool. Win: gain [blue]100[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold]. Lose: take a [gold]Sip[/gold].
SPIRITS_SEVEN_GRAND.pages.BARTENDERS_PIC:
The bartender reaches for the [gold]top shelf[/gold] without looking.

It [jitter][red]burns[/red][/jitter] all the way down, and leaves [sine][gold]something behind[/gold][/sine].
SPIRITS_SEVEN_GRAND.pages.FLIGHT.descrip:
[orange]Three small glasses[/orange], three long stories.

You remember [sine]about half of each[/sine].
SPIRITS_SEVEN_GRAND.pages.POOL_WIN.descr: You sink the [purple]eight ball[/purple] on a [jitter][gold]bank shot[/gold][/jitter] you'll be bragging about for weeks.
SPIRITS_SEVEN_GRAND.pages.LEAVE.descript: You leave the whiskey to the [gold]stag[/gold].
